data.section: 1.3 Plants `[AR26]`

title: CUMMINSIND_practice › 1.3 Plants `[AR26]`

body:
`thesis:paper-call:CUMMINSIND:q3fy27-opm-17pct-plus` (made 2026-11-21, P = 0.38, base 0.45). Our rules forbid editing a call after it is made. Facts surfaced here that its reasoning did **not** use, recorded for the post-mortem:
- **Q2 FY27 OPM was 15.3%** [506 ÷ 3,301]. It **included an unquantified one-off "true-up" of corporate cost allocations** in other expenses `[CC-Q2FY27]`. Other expenses were 9.66% of sales against 8.34% a year earlier (+₹54 cr). If ₹25–40 cr was the one-off [EST], normalised Q2 OPM ≈ 16.1–16.5%. Reaching 17% then needs only ~0.5–0.9 pp more from pricing and materials.
- **For YES:** pig iron/steel flat to softer in Oct–Nov 2026 `[WEB]`; price hikes "starting" on new orders `[CC-Q2FY27]`; H1 receivables released.
- **For NO:** the inventory layer at high cost (+₹186 cr in H1) flows into Q3 COGS; employee cost +18% YoY is recurring; management refused to call a bottom; order-book execution at old prices.
- Net: the one-off is the most decision-relevant new fact. **Lesson for the paper-call method: read the other-expenses commentary before setting a margin probability.**

title: lessons › L9 (2026-11-20) — Method tests are not recommendations

body:
1. **Market cap is approximate.** It is built from implied shares in PIT disclosures (holding ≥ 1%) plus a price-basis
   factor. Error is likely ±5–10%, which is fine for ×0.5–×2 matching and for the ₹500–20,000 cr band edges. 52 events were
   lost for lack of a share count or mcap.
2. **Control universe** = companies with any PIT filing in 2020-12 → 2025-01 (≈ all actively traded NSE names). It is not a
   point-in-time NSE equity list. Firms listed after the window (and so absent) cannot be drawn for early dates, a small
   bias.
3. **Skew.** Mean +6%, median −7%. The rule's economic value depends on holding the whole basket, so that the few 3–5×
   winners are captured. A concentrated version (5–10 names) would usually lag.
4. **One regime.** 2021–24 was the strongest Indian small/mid-cap run in a decade. Promoter buyers in metals, capital goods
   and rail rode that wave; part of the +6% may be sector or momentum exposure that size-matching does not remove. No
   sector-matched control was run.
5. **Coverage drift.** NSE PIT row counts halve from 2021 to 2024. If some promoter purchases were disclosed only on BSE
   or under different modes, the event set is incomplete. The magnitude of the drift was not verified.
6. **Costs and impact** are ignored (₹500–2,000 cr names: 0.5–1% round trip plus impact). They would cut the small-cap mean.
7. Index benchmark is NIFTY 500 *price* (no dividends), so the index comparison flatters events by about 1.2%/yr. It is
   context only.

data.section: 5. Credibility-generated forward calls (rule-set probabilities)

title: US-WTS › 5. Credibility-generated forward calls (rule-set probabilities)

body:
- **Small n and mostly pending.** 43 of 82 promises are scored, and every FY2026 item is pending. Refresh after the Q4-2026 calls (late Jan–Feb 2027).
- **Reading depth.** The ledgers come from the Motley Fool takeaway lists, the full CFO outlook sections and targeted greps, not a line-by-line read. Quotes marked [Fool summary] are the transcriber's paraphrase. Four of 24 calls were read from 8-K press releases only, because no Fool transcript was found and guessed URLs returned 404. For Lincoln, that leaves two quarters nearly empty.
- **Single-source outcomes.** Organic growth, adjusted margins, segment figures and adjusted EPS come from the companies' own later calls and releases. GAAP revenue, operating income, EPS, capex, FCF, buybacks and dividends were re-derived from SEC XBRL (second source).
- **A. O. Smith's basis change.** China moved to discontinued operations in Q4-2026. Total-company FY2026 promises made before October are scored *withdrawn* or measured ex-China. The structured revenue call checks that the 10-K comparative is ex-China (~$3,155 mn).
- **Peer medians at 100%.** With three peers that rarely miss, one partly-delivered capex promise moves SAC by 5–10 pts. US SAC values are noisier than India's.
- **Survivorship and selection:** four listed, profitable, dividend-paying firms in a 2025–26 data-centre/price upcycle. A downturn sample would look different.
